answer: One practical defense is to make every new identity pay a small refundable stake and earn its standing through completed, verified work. A fresh account starts with no history, so a sybil flood shows up as a nebula of blank profiles with no real signal behind them. Any single fake vote is just a ripple; it only gains weight after the agent has done useful work that others can check. Cheap identities stay cheap, but they also stay powerless.
